item.title: Paper: Industrial ReMEmbR: Scaling Spatiotemporal Memory to Robot Fleets
item.description: This system enables warehouse robot fleets to share a memory of past events without overloading servers by only processing visual data when specifically requested.

item.title: Paper: Capable Teacher, Myopic Scorer: Reward-Free Teacher Repair for Agentic On-Policy Distillation
item.description: The authors identify that agent training fails not just because of student errors, but because teachers often provide poor guidance in unfamiliar states, requiring better teacher-student alignment.

item.title: Paper: Cache Engineering for Agents
item.description: This work introduces techniques to manage LLM memory usage by optimizing how key-value caches are stored and updated, preventing performance degradation during long task sequences.

item.title: Paper: When Do LLMs Help with Feature Selection? A Systematic Empirical Study
item.description: This study evaluates when using LLMs for feature selection outperforms traditional statistical methods, providing guidance on when semantic context actually adds value to tabular data tasks.

item.title: Paper: OpenVLHarness: Real World Visual Agentic Tool-Use with Multimodal Memory
item.description: This framework improves multimodal agents by integrating external tools and memory, helping them solve complex visual tasks that base models cannot handle through reasoning alone.

item.title: Paper: WeAct: Dynamic Weight Switching as Agent Actions
item.description: This method prevents catastrophic forgetting in long-horizon agents by dynamically switching between specialized LoRA adapters during task execution instead of using static model weights.

item.title: Paper: CoopUQ: Robust Multi-Robot Social Navigation via Uncertainty-Aware Cooperative Forecasting
item.description: This framework improves multi-robot navigation safety by allowing robots to share uncertainty estimates, enabling better coordination in unpredictable human-shared environments.

item.title: Paper: Where is Physical RSI capability from? An Observational Scaling Law of LLM-as-policy
item.description: This study establishes a systematic way to measure how well language models improve their physical manipulation skills through self-correction, identifying key bottlenecks in their learning process.

item.title: Paper: Behavioral Couplings: From Formation to Behavioral Emergence in Language Models
item.description: The researchers demonstrate that fine-tuning LLMs for one behavior can unintentionally trigger unrelated, secondary behaviors, which is a critical risk factor for developers managing model safety and alignment.

item.title: Paper: On the possibilities and limitations of LLM-based multi-agent systems for multi-criteria decision-making in healthcare operations management
item.description: This paper provides a framework to evaluate the reliability of LLM agents when they act as proxies for human stakeholders in complex healthcare decision-making tasks.

item.title: Paper: DLite: History-free Speculative Decoding for Agentic AI
item.description: The authors introduce a new speculative decoding method that improves inference speed for agentic AI by eliminating the need for historical KV cache, which often slows down long-running tasks.

item.title: Paper: Tool Recommendation for Multi-Step Agents: Finding Every Tool a Task Needs
item.description: This system enables agents to access thousands of tools by using a gateway that dynamically recommends the right tools for a task, bypassing standard context window limitations.

item.title: Paper: PhySGA: A Physics-Space Grounded Agentic Framework for Generalizable and Interactive 3D Composition
item.description: This framework improves 3D object placement by grounding AI agents in physical laws, helping developers create more realistic simulations and interactive digital environments.

item.title: Paper: Bayesian Learning to Select Fair Classifiers
item.description: This Bayesian approach helps data scientists dynamically select the best models in real-time streams while balancing prediction accuracy with fairness constraints.

item.title: Paper: Hierarchical Residual Policy Learning for Real-World Mobile Manipulation with Sparse Human Guidance
item.description: This method uses a hierarchical architecture to efficiently fine-tune robotic manipulation tasks with minimal human intervention, making real-world deployment more practical.

item.title: Paper: Player-1: Learning to Play from Synthetic Experience
item.description: This framework enables AI agents to master complex video games using synthetic experiences, reducing the reliance on massive sets of human gameplay demonstrations.

item.title: Paper: Back-Translation Still Matters: Leveraging Monolingual Data for Low-Resource Machine Translation with LLMs
item.description: The authors show that using back-translation with monolingual data significantly improves machine translation performance in low-resource languages compared to relying solely on few-shot prompting or fine-tuning.

item.title: Paper: SkillScaffold: Scaffolding Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Policy-Adaptive Skill Credit Assignment and Selective Injection
item.description: This paper introduces a method to improve agentic reinforcement learning by selectively injecting and evaluating relevant skills, reducing the computational cost and instability of traditional rollout-based credit assignment.

item.title: Paper: ProAS: A Progress-Aware Advantage Shaping Framework for Multi-Turn Agentic Reinforcement Learning
item.description: The authors propose a framework that improves how LLM agents learn by assigning credit more intelligently across multi-turn actions, avoiding the pitfalls of uniform reward distribution without needing extra critic models.

item.title: Paper: ChunkAct: Action Chunking for Agentic Robotics
item.description: By grouping robotic actions into chunks, this method reduces the redundant reasoning overhead of LLMs in control loops, making robot task execution significantly more efficient.
